packageRules.description: Vault is tag+digest in group_vars/all.yml and the two must move together. Renovate cannot derive a digest from a tag, so a tag-only bump would leave a digest that no longer matches the tag and the pull would fail. Operator-runbook path until the pin collapses to one line.
Locally built images have no upstream to look up; their build base is covered by the dockerfile manager instead.

forgejo and nginx live in compose/group_vars/all.yml, which has no digest field for forgejo. Digest pinning these two is deferred to docs/musings/digest-pinning-plan.md so the compose default and the Ansible var cannot drift apart.
One PR per ecosystem's patch-level churn instead of one per package.
Minor updates stay separate so a bad minor is one revert away from a known-good patch state.
Major updates are never auto-merged by the age gate; the label is the human signal.
Hold new PyPI releases for a week. PyPI serves an upload timestamp for every version.

Hold new container tags for a week where the registry reports a push time (Docker Hub). Codeberg, data.forgejo.org, ghcr and lscr do not, so there the hold is the merge automation's PR-age fallback, not this setting.
Hold new action tags for a week.

customManagers.description: Forgejo image tag in the Ansible vars. group_vars/all.yml is what the first-boot compose .env is rendered from, so bumping only the compose default would not reach a fresh install.
nginx image in the Ansible vars (same first-boot .env reason as forgejo).
